spans.s: वैवधिक m. 1. A pedlar, a hawker; 2. a load-carrier.
वैवर्ण्य n. 1. Change of complexion, paleness; 2. difference, diversity.
वैवस्वत (I) m. 1. Name of the seventh Manu now reigning, दत्तेंद्राभयदक्षिणैर्भगवतो वैवस्वतादा मनोः Ut.vi.; 2. the planet Saturn; 3. an epithet of Yama.
वैवस्वत (II) n. The present age, presided over by the seventh Manu.
वैवस्वती f. 1. The southern quarter; 2. an epithet of Yamunā.
वैवाहिक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to marriage, matrimonial, K.S.vii.2.
वैवाहिक (II) m.n. A marriage, a wedding.
वैवाहिक (III) m. The bride or bridegroom’s father-in-law.
वैवाहिक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to marriage, matrimonial, K.S.vii.2.
